parole.testo: Inherited from Old Lithuanian karãlius, from Old Ruthenian король (korolʹ) or Old East Slavic король (korolĭ), from Proto-Slavic *kõrľь.

Borrowed from Old Ruthenian сябръ (sjabr, “relative; companion”) (from which Belarusian ся́бар (sjábar) descended), from Old East Slavic сѧбръ (sębrŭ), from Proto-Slavic *sębrъ. Cognate with Latgalian sābrys (“neighbor”), Slovene sreber and possibly Proto-Finnic *sëpra (“companionship”)
